title: BackgroundTask starts before the response has been sent when BaseHTTPMiddleware is in the stack
author: Mukller
body_preview: With a `BaseHTTPMiddleware` anywhere in the stack, a `BackgroundTask` attached to a response starts running **before the last byte of the response has been sent** to the client.
